labels.title: Add a label
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Pick whether the initialization code should be generated and automatically called at startup.

oneOf.title: Callable
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated and called in peripheral initialization.

oneOf.title: Generated
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated but not called in peripheral initialization.

clock_source.title: Clock source
clock_source.description: Clock source can be modified in the clock tree.

actions.message: Make sure that HSE is enabled into RCC panel

clock_frequency.title: Clock frequency
clock_frequency.description: Clock frequency can be modified in the clock tree.

bus_usage.title: Bus usage
bus_usage.description: I3C controller mode: using only I3C or mixed I3C + I2C.

freq_i3c.title: I3C frequency
freq_i3c.description: I3C controller frequency (kHz). It must be between 124 kHz and 12.5 MHz.

freq_i2c.title: I2C frequency
freq_i2c.description: I2C controller frequency (kHz). It must be between 87 kHz and 1 MHz.

duty_cycle_i3c.title: Duty cycle I3C (%)
duty_cycle_i3c.description: Duty cycle I3C. It must be between 0% and 50%.

duty_cycle_i2c.title: Duty cycle I3C and I2C (%)
duty_cycle_i2c.description: Duty cycle I3C and I2C. It must be between 0% and 50%.

ctrl_timing_reg0.title: Timing register 0
ctrl_timing_reg0.description: I3C_TIMINGR0 value is directly calculated by CubeMX2.

actions.message: One of the bitfields computed for Timing Register 0 is out of the 0–255 range. Possible cause: clock source frequency too high or too low for the requested bus clock frequency.

sda_rise_time.title: Hardware timing constraints: SDA rise time
sda_rise_time.description: Time (ns) for SDA to rise to 70% VDD from GND (capacitive effect). For example, value measured on a Nucleo board is about 350 ns.

sda_hold_time.title: SDA hold time
sda_hold_time.description: SDA hold time in terms of the number of kernel clock periods.

wait_time.title: Activity state of the new controller (ASNCR)
wait_time.description: Used to calculate the time that the main and new controllers must wait before issuing a START condition.

bus_free_duration.title: Bus free duration
bus_free_duration.description: The duration after a stop and before a start (ns). It must be between 20 ns and 2042 ns.

bus_idle_duration.title: Bus idle duration
bus_idle_duration.description: An extended duration of the bus free to allow the devices to hot join the I3C bus. It must be between 200000 ns and 205601 ns.

ctrl_timing_reg1.title: Timing register 1
ctrl_timing_reg1.description: I3C_TIMINGR1 register value is calculated by CubeMX2.

ctrl_adv_timing_reg1.title: Timing register 1
ctrl_adv_timing_reg1.description: I3C_TIMINGR1 register value is calculated by CubeMX2.

bus_available_duration.title: Bus available duration
bus_available_duration.description: Minimum idle time with SDA and SCL high before next transaction. It must be between 1000 ns and 2008 ns.

tgt_timing_reg1.title: Timing register 1
tgt_timing_reg1.description: I3C_TIMINGR1 register value is calculated by CubeMX2.

tgt_adv_timing_reg1.title: Timing register 1
tgt_adv_timing_reg1.description: I3C_TIMINGR1 register value is calculated by CubeMX2.

own_dyn_addr.title: Own dynamic address
own_dyn_addr.description: The controller dynamic address when it becomes a target. It must be between 1 and 127.

stall_time.title: Stall time
stall_time.description: Controller clock stall time (ns). It must be between 0 ns and 1020 ns. It is applied to ACK, CCC t-bit, Tx parity and Rx parity if enabled.

ack.title: ACK stalling
ack.description: Controller clock stall on the ACK phase.

tx_parity.title: Tx parity stalling
tx_parity.description: Controller clock stall on the parity phase of data to allow the target to read received data.

rx_parity.title: Rx parity stalling
rx_parity.description: Controller clock stall on the T bit phase of data enable to allow the target to prepare data to be sent.

ack_i2c.title: I2C ACK stalling
ack_i2c.description: Controller clock stall on the I2C ACK phase.

tx_parity_i2c.title: I2C Tx parity stalling
tx_parity_i2c.description: Controller clock stall on the I2C parity phase of data to allow the target to read received data.

rx_parity_i2c.title: I2C Rx parity stalling
rx_parity_i2c.description: Controller clock stall on the I2C T bit phase of data enable to allow the target to prepare data to be sent.

ctrl_reset_pattern.title: Reset pattern
ctrl_reset_pattern.description: Inserts a target reset pattern before the STOP of a transmitted frame containing a RSTACT CCC command.

tgt_identifier.title: Target characteristic ID
tgt_identifier.description: The target characteristic ID (MIPI named reference DCR). It must be a value between 0 and 255.

tgt_mipi_identifier.title: MIPI identifier
tgt_mipi_identifier.description: The bits [12-15] of the 48-provisioned ID (MIPI named reference PID), other 48-provisioned ID are hardcoded. It must be a value between 0 and 15.

pending_read_mandatory_data_byte.title: Pending read mandatory data byte
pending_read_mandatory_data_byte.description: Target transmission of mandatory data bytes indicating a pending read notification in response to the GETCAPR Common Command Code (CCC), which requests the target capabilities of the devices.

hand_off_activity_state.title: Activity state after hand-off
hand_off_activity_state.description: Target activity state when becoming controller.

group_address.title: Group address
group_address.description: Target support for group address after a controller-role hand-off.

read_data_size.title: Max read data size (bytes)
read_data_size.description: The number of data bytes that the target can read at most. It must be a value between 0 and 65535.

write_data_size.title: Max write data size (bytes)
write_data_size.description: The number of data bytes that the target can write at most. It must be a value between 0 and 65535.

speed.title: Max read turn-around within GETMXDS CCC
speed.description: The GETMXDS CCC is used to query a target device for its maximum supported data speed and related timing limitations.

ta_duration.title: Clock to data turn-around time (tSCO)
ta_duration.description: Minimum interval between the falling edge of SCL and the moment when SDA changes state.

ta_max_read.title: Max read turn-around
ta_max_read.description: Number of bytes the controller must wait (or insert as delay) after completing a read before the next bus transaction. This parameter must be between 0 and 255.

security_privilege.title: Security and privilege
security_privilege.description: Manage security and privileged access levels attributes.

security.title: Security attribute
security.description: Set the security attribute of the securable peripheral.

actions.message: The security attribute of the peripheral is automatically set to secure when the peripheral is bound to a secure resource and to non-secure when it is not. Manual configuration is not allowed.

privilege.title: Privileged attribute
privilege.description: Manage the privileged attribute of a securable RISC peripheral.

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: Optional. Lock security and privilege attributes to prevent changes.

actions.message: Secure-only mode: Illegal access interrupt is forced to disabled.
